update_message.en: A new version is available with important fixes.

news.title: Welcome to Gridborn!
news.message: Build your party, master positioning, and conquer the grid!

tips: Position cards strategically - flanking gives bonus damage!
Equipment unlocks are tied to your progress - discover new gear by winning!
Cards with Haste attack before normal combat resolution.
Elements can be consumed for powerful bonuses - match your equipment!
Place tanky heroes in the contested zone and ranged attackers in your back row.
Side attacks only hit enemies in the contested zone - position them wisely!
Auto-play struggles against bosses. Take manual control for tough fights!
Auto-equip is handy for quick setups, but optimize your gear before bosses.
Flanking and Supported bonuses stack - surround enemies for devastating damage!
